title: rivet sources file
description: Every source database of an Airflow deployment and its settings, read by airflow_provider_rivet.dags.build_dags_from_file (airflow-provider-rivet 0.4.0 and later). `{name}` in any text value is replaced by the source's name.

version.description: The format of this file; 1 is the only one.

config_dir.description: Where each source's rivet config `<name>.yaml` lives; a relative path is read against this file's folder. Default `rivet`, beside this file.

state_root.description: The parent of every source's state folder `<state_root>/<name>`: a volume every worker mounts at the same path.

state_connection.description: The Airflow Connection (type postgres) of the PostgreSQL server that holds each source's state database.

source_connection.description: The Airflow Connection of a source, `{name}` replaced; default `{name}`.

odbc_ini.description: The odbc.ini whose data source `[<name>]` is used when no Connection has the source's id; null turns it off. Default /etc/odbc.ini.

template.description: A source of this file whose existing config gives the GCS bucket, the BigQuery project and the TLS mode to the sources that have no config yet; `defaults` and a source's own settings win over it.

defaults.description: Settings of every source; a source's own win.

sources.description: Each source by name (an Airflow Connection id part, a file stem and a database name: lower-case letters, digits and `_`), with its own settings; `{}` or nothing for none.

globs.description: Table names or globs (`*` any run, `?` one character, case-sensitive, the whole name). Quote a glob that starts with `*`: "*_tmp".

include.description: `rivet init --include`: keep only the tables these globs match.

exclude.description: `rivet init --exclude`: drop the tables these globs match; wins over include.

tls.description: `rivet init --tls`: how rivet reaches the source.

tls_ca.description: `rivet init --tls-ca`: a PEM CA file on the worker.

bigquery_dataset.description: `rivet init --bigquery-dataset`; give each source its own, e.g. `{name}`.

init_args.description: More `rivet init` arguments, as written; a flag a setting above sets is refused here.

state_database.description: The state database on the state server; default `rivet_state_{name}`. `connection`: the database the state Connection names itself (a DAG moved from build_cdc_dag).

schedule.description: The DAG's schedule (cron or preset); null: triggered only.

start_date.description: The DAG's start_date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the past.

tags.description: Tags added to the DAG's own.

cloud_credentials.description: The worker's cloud credentials rivet receives (`cloud_credentials` of every task).

env_from_variables.description: An environment variable per Airflow Variable key, `{name}` replaced in the key.
